ci_support_win_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
target_platform:
- win-64

about.description:
Winpty is a Windows software package providing an interface similar to a Unix
pty-master for communicating with Windows console programs. The package
consists of a library (libwinpty) and a tool for Cygwin and MSYS for running
Windows console programs in a Cygwin/MSYS pty.
about.summary:
Winpty provides an interface similar to a Unix pty-master for communicating
with Windows console programs.

name: winpty
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "winpty" %}
{% set version = "0.4.3" %}
{% set hash = "093037c39f9c899d79b74d5e15ff74fb59a98c492c5ed621e97e1090c3442865" %}

package:
  name: {{ name }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  - fn: {{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
    url: https://github.com/rprichard/{{ name }}/archive/{{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: {{ hash }}
    patches:
      - 0001-disable-msys-compiler-check.patch
  # Use upstream's MSVC/GYP build for ARM64. gyp-next is a build-only tool.
  - url: https://github.com/nodejs/gyp-next/archive/refs/tags/v0.22.2.tar.gz  # [target_platform == "win-arm64"]
    sha256: eec4d9ca36028a28bffa6313fb7db51d664f06f49387cb734369777a55730d4d  # [target_platform == "win-arm64"]
    folder: gyp-next  # [target_platform == "win-arm64"]

build:
  number: 5
  skip: True  # [not win]

requirements:
  build:
    - posix  # [target_platform != "win-arm64"]
    - m2w64-toolchain  # [target_platform != "win-arm64"]
    - {{ compiler('cxx') }}  # [target_platform == "win-arm64"]
    - {{ stdlib('c') }}  # [target_platform == "win-arm64"]
    - python >=3.9  # [target_platform == "win-arm64"]
    - packaging >=24  # [target_platform == "win-arm64"]
    - setuptools >=77.0.3  # [target_platform == "win-arm64"]

test:
  requires:
    - {{ compiler('cxx') }}  # [target_platform == "win-arm64"]
  files:
    - test_winpty.c  # [target_platform == "win-arm64"]
  commands:
    - winpty-agent --version
    - call %CXX% /nologo /MD /W4 /I"%LIBRARY_INC%" test_winpty.c /link /LIBPATH:"%LIBRARY_LIB%" winpty.lib /OUT:winpty-consumer.exe  # [target_platform == "win-arm64"]
    - dumpbin /imports winpty-consumer.exe | findstr /I /C:"winpty.dll"  # [target_platform == "win-arm64"]
    - winpty-consumer.exe  # [target_platform == "win-arm64"]
    - dumpbin /headers winpty-consumer.exe | findstr /I /C:"AA64 machine (ARM64)"  # [target_platform == "win-arm64"]
    - dumpbin /headers "%LIBRARY_BIN%\winpty.dll" | findstr /I /C:"AA64 machine (ARM64)"  # [target_platform == "win-arm64"]
    - dumpbin /headers "%LIBRARY_BIN%\winpty-agent.exe" | findstr /I /C:"AA64 machine (ARM64)"  # [target_platform == "win-arm64"]

about:
  home: https://github.com/rprichard/winpty
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: |
    Winpty provides an interface similar to a Unix pty-master for communicating
    with Windows console programs.
  description: |
    Winpty is a Windows software package providing an interface similar to a Unix
    pty-master for communicating with Windows console programs. The package
    consists of a library (libwinpty) and a tool for Cygwin and MSYS for running
    Windows console programs in a Cygwin/MSYS pty.
  doc_url: https://github.com/rprichard/winpty
  dev_url: https://github.com/rprichard/winpty

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - blink1073
    - ccordoba12
    - andfoy
